decisions.reason: Narrowing the corridor and relocating Unit 3 bathroom fixtures does not change the requirement for one steel entrance door per dwelling.
The source does not change retention or shared use of the existing main entrance door.
The requested corridor, wall, drain, and shower changes do not affect the balcony-retention rule.
The source does not necessarily alter the established Unit 3 counter arrangement or bathroom-door clearance strategy.
Moving an adjacent room wall by 10 cm does not necessarily change Unit 1's 2+1 program or room counts.
The specific 10 cm wall shift does not repeal the general policy of preserving existing walls wherever possible or alter the recorded marked-wall actions.
The corridor and Unit 3 bathroom adjustments do not change the required total of three dwellings.
The source explicitly concerns the Unit 3 bathroom and does not change the Unit 1 toilet location or drain-alignment requirement.
The source does not change the open-plan kitchen configuration, cabinet quantities, or cabinet dimensions.
The 10 cm design change does not alter the requirement to include room dimensions in the plan.

The source's required impact is already represented by the existing message-48 MODIFY setting the Unit 3 drain and shower locations to the left wall; no additional updates, removals, or scope changes are required.
